title: Post Training Evaluation
subtitle: Your own training evaluations.
explanation: Post Training Evaluation (PTE) is an evaluation carried out by a supervisor on their team's participation in a training program. Its purpose is to find out whether the material delivered has been/is still being implemented/applied in the job, including whether there has been a change in work attitude (available to the supervisor as soon as the training is closed, with 30 days to complete it).
